kaikki_vikisozluk.e: غَضَا • (ḡaḍā) I (non-past يَغْضُو (yaḡḍū), verbal noun غُضُوّ (ḡuḍuww))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From figurative uses in relation to the غَضًا (ḡaḍan) plant, in high demand by camels to bite off and by travels for shadow.
g: to be dark and cover everything

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From figurative uses in relation to the غَضًا (ḡaḍan) plant, in high demand by camels to bite off and by travels for shadow.
g: to be in good condition and abundant
